notes.title: Playtest Version 71.x
notes.content:
Playtest Version 0.71.0
+++++++++++++++++++++++++
[list]
[*] Most details in this video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0KbfxDkBV3o
[*] Crusher collection bugs fixed
[*] Dropoff queuing fixed 
[*] Crane bug with repositioning the transit poitns fixed
[*] Relay bug fixed
[*] Drills have a data view
[*] Drills can be turned off or toggle auto tagging
[*] Astronaut is on the shuttle!
[*] There' s a knowledge base
[*] Worth watching the video!!
[/list]

Playtest version 0.71.1 
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where turrets attached to a commandbot were not being put back in storage correctly and marked as AWAY
[/list]

Playtest version 0.71.2 
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
[list]
[*] Sell Resources terminal no longer defaults to "sell all". Players must select each resources they want to sell.
[*] Contracts Terminal now shows notifications for corporations that have completed contracts outstanding
[*] Contracts Terminal fixed glitchyness when completing contracts.
[*] Pathfinding algorithm update
[*] Fixed collider so astronaut can't get stuck in shuttle launch room
[*] Fixed Drill so that it leaves behind scrap metal when destroyed
[*] Hoping little red lines showing up on Knowledge Base are fixed (haven't seen them since but they were irregular)
[/list]

Playtest version 0.71.3 
++++++++++++++++++++++++
[list]
[*] Fixed workerbot reset bug that caused shuttle equipment storage to block vacant slots
[*] Fixed Level 2 handheld laser (description corrected + molten iron production fixed with new chip pooling system)
[*] Fixed the shuttle launch interaction so you cannot overshoot it 
[*] Fixed z-fighting on freighter exterior during hyperjump
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Version 0.68.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with iron spawning almost double what it should
[*] Changed Forge capacity to 90 Molten units (prev 60)
[*] Changed Forge melting rate to 1 molten / sec (prev 2/sec)
[*] Improved battery charging speed on shutttle from 5.5 to 15
[*] Fixed bugs with forge pulling from crates
[*] UI Improvements 
[*] Fixed bug with weapon aim glitching when aiming near bottom of screeen
[*] Fix for resource auto-eject / sticky chips issue
[*] Reduced the starting area radius on a new worksite so not to interrupt ongoing work until area is defined by player
[/list]
